title: 云海剑台演示
logline: 少年剑修在浮空石台挥剑破阵。
global_style: 高品质3D国风玄幻动画电影，三维角色建模与PBR材质，电影级体积光，青金色能量粒子，竖屏电影构图，主体清晰完整入镜

少年剑修.anchor: 少年剑修，青年男性，黑色高束发，深青色金纹长袍，银色肩甲，手持银灰长剑；所有镜头保持同一面部、发型、服装与道具。

shots.description: 少年剑修立于云海上方的浮空石台，双脚稳固，手持长剑蓄势，青金能量沿剑刃流动，衣袍随风摆动，人物全身和长剑完整入镜。
shots.video_prompt: High-end 3D Chinese fantasy animation. The same young swordsman rotates his torso and performs one clear horizontal sword slash. A blue-gold energy arc follows the blade, sparks trail behind, robe and ponytail react naturally. Preserve the same face, costume and sword.
shots.speaker: 少年剑修

shots.description: 少年剑修落地半蹲，长剑点向石台，圆形阵纹亮起，青金色冲击波沿地面扩散，远处云海和悬浮山峰清晰可见。
shots.video_prompt: High-end 3D Chinese fantasy animation. The same armored swordsman lands in a low crouch and drives the sword tip toward the platform. A circular blue-gold shockwave expands across the stone floor and particles scatter. Keep the same face, costume and sword with clear readable motion.
shots.speaker: 少年剑修
